semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Taika Industry specializes in stainless steel polishing and press plates used in manufacturing processes relevant to semiconductor applications.
summary: Taika Industry is a manufacturer of stainless steel polishing products and super-hard press plates, which are utilized in the production of printed circuit boards and other semiconductor-related materials. With over 30 years of expertise, they offer consultation from prototype development to mass production, focusing on durability and efficiency in their products.
